messages:
Maya: Thinking of doing a tiny backyard hang Saturday night — low-key firepit, blankets, marshmallows. Who's in? :fire: 
Tony: Count me in. I can bring a big pot of chili and some brews. :thumbsup: 
Olivia: Sounds cozy. There's also a small food market + outdoor live jazz in the park that evening. Might be a nice early thing. :notes: 
Sam: I would love a park stroll, but allergic to smoke, so if we do firepit pls keep it smokeless/low. :sneezing_face: 
Maya: @Sam no worries, I can make the pit small and have a no-open-smoke area on the porch. Kid- and dog-friendly too. :dog: 
Tony: What time were you thinking? I can do 7pm onwards. 
Olivia: Park jazz starts at 6, ends ~8:30. We could do early jazz then head to Maya's for s'mores. 
Maya: Hybrid plan sounds good — meet at the park 6:15 for a set, then Maya's around 8:45 for chill. 
Dev-Bot: Heads-up: Social events > 8 ppl should post in #rnd-social for logistics. Also RSVP link: https://tiny.redwood.social/rsvp :robot_face: 
Tony: I'll RSVP. Also bringing extra folding chairs. 
Sam: If it's hybrid, I'm good. Less smoke exposure that way. 
Olivia: I'll bring cookies and coordinate a ride share. DMing people who need a lift. 
Maya: Can someone bring bug spray? Last time mosquitoes were aggressive. :mosquito: 
Tony: I'll add citronella candles + spray to my list. 
Olivia: Quick poll, react with :fire: for backyard-first, :park: for park-first. I'll tally. 
Tony: :fire: (but still fine with park first) 
Maya: :fire: (but happy hybrid) 
Sam: :park: 
Olivia: :park: 
Dev-Bot: Auto-note: if anyone posts "potluck" also ping #office-supplies for plates. 
Maya: Looks split. I can host either way. I'll post address + parking notes after we lock time. 
Tony: Great. See y'all Saturday. 
Sam: Thanks Maya — bringing my reusable mug. :coffee: 
Olivia: I'll make a small playlist for the park set and the firepit, suggestions welcome. 
Maya: Add campfire songs! Ukulele optional. :guitar: 
Tony: Ill bring chili + a bluetooth speaker. 
Dev-Bot: Reminder: be considerate of neighbors re: noise after 10pm. :bell: 
Maya: Noted. We'll keep it mellow. RSVP in the link if you plan to attend. 
Sam: Excited :)
